calculate_list_scores.lua_script:
-- 序融合（Order-based ES）：在 list_num 个 list 级别分数上做 ES 排名融合
                  -- list_score_weight_pairs: {{list=list_level_scores, weight=w}, ...}
                  -- 返回长度为 list_num 的 es_scores（初始均为 1.0，逐步累乘）
                  local function calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                    local EPS = 1e-9
                    local es_scores = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      es_scores[i] = 1.0
                    end

                    for _, pair in ipairs(list_score_weight_pairs) do
                      local score_list = pair.list
                      local weight = pair.weight

                      -- 构建 (index, score) 对并按 score 降序排序
                      local score_pairs = {}
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        local s = score_list ~= nil and (score_list[i] or 0.0) or 0.0
                        score_pairs[i] = {idx = i, score = s}
                      end
                      table.sort(score_pairs, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)

                      -- 按排名累乘，分数相同时复用上一个 rank
                      local rank = 0
                      for i = 1, #score_pairs do
                        local sp = score_pairs[i]
                        if i == 1 or math.abs(sp.score - score_pairs[i-1].score) > EPS then
                          rank = i
                        end
                        es_scores[sp.idx] = es_scores[sp.idx] * (1.0 / (rank + 10.0)) ^ weight
                      end
                    end

                    return es_scores
                  end

                  function calculate_list_scores()
                    local n = #pvtr
                    if n ~= rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size or n ~= #pltr or n % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                      error("输入列表长度不一致或不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                    end
                    local list_num = n // rerank_list_item_size
                    local scores = {}
                    -- 序融合模式：
                    -- Step1: 对每个 pxtr 在 list 内做 item->list 聚合，得到 list 级别分数
                    -- Step2: 在 list 级别做 ES 序融合（weight > 0 才参与）
                    -- Step3: 最终的 list score 就是 es_score（已是 list 级别，无需再累加）
                    if use_order_es == 1 then
                      local list_score_weight_pairs = {}
                      if expected_wt_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_pvtr_wt, weight=expected_wt_weight} end
                      if expected_wt_v2_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_pvtr_wt_v2, weight=expected_wt_v2_weight} end
                      if expected_wt_v3_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_pvtr_wt_v3, weight=expected_wt_v3_weight} end
                      if expected_ltr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_ltr, weight=expected_ltr_weight} end
                      if expected_pctr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_pctr, weight=expected_pctr_weight} end
                      if expected_comment_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_comment, weight=expected_comment_weight} end
                      if expected_like_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_like, weight=expected_like_weight} end
                      if expected_follow_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=expected_follow, weight=expected_follow_weight} end
                      -- expected_* 为 list 维度，不适合通过 aggregate_to_list_level 从 item 聚合，跳过
                      local es_scores = calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        scores[i] = es_scores[i]
                      end
                      return scores
                    end

                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      local start_idx = (i - 1) * rerank_list_item_size
                      local es_i = 0.0
                      local list_es_i = 0.0
                      local expected_wt_reward = expected_wt_weight * expected_pvtr_wt[i] * 0.1
                      local expected_wt_v2_reward = expected_wt_v2_weight * expected_pvtr_wt_v2[i] * 0.1
                      local expected_wt_v3_reward = expected_wt_v3_weight * expected_pvtr_wt_v3[i] * 0.1
                      local expected_ltr_reward = expected_ltr_weight * expected_ltr[i]
                      local expected_pctr_reward = expected_pctr_weight * expected_pctr[i]
                      local expected_comment_reward = expected_comment_weight * expected_comment[i] * 100.0
                      local expected_like_reward = expected_like_weight * expected_like[i] * 50.0
                      local expected_follow_reward = expected_follow_weight * expected_follow[i] * 100.0
                      if use_multiply == 1 then
                        local list_multiply_score = 1.0
                        if expected_wt_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_pvtr_wt[i]) ^ expected_wt_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_pvtr_wt_v2 > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_pvtr_wt_v2[i]) ^ expected_wt_v2_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_pvtr_wt_v3 > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_pvtr_wt_v3[i]) ^ expected_wt_v3_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_ltr_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_ltr[i]) ^ expected_ltr_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_pctr_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_pctr[i]) ^ expected_pctr_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_like_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_like[i]) ^ expected_like_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_follow_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_follow[i]) ^ expected_follow_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_comment_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_comment[i]) ^ expected_comment_weight)
                        end
                        list_es_i = list_multiply_score
                      else
                        list_es_i = expected_wt_reward + expected_wt_v2_reward + expected_wt_v3_reward + expected_ltr_reward + expected_pctr_reward + expected_comment_reward + expected_like_reward + expected_follow_reward
                      end
                      if i < rerank_list_true_num + 1 then
                        for j = 1, rerank_list_item_size do
                          local context_pwtd_reward = context_pwtd_weight * context_pwtd[start_idx + j]
                          local context_pctr_reward = context_pctr_weight * context_pctr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local context_plvtr_reward = context_plvtr_weight * context_plvtr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local context_psvtr_reward = context_psvtr_weight * (1 - context_psvtr[start_idx + j]) * 10.0
                          local context_pltr_reward = context_pltr_weight * context_pltr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pcmtr_reward = context_pcmtr_weight * context_pcmtr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pwtr_reward = context_pwtr_weight * context_pwtr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pftr_reward = context_pftr_weight * context_pftr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local pvtr_reward = pvtr_weight * pvtr[start_idx + j]
                          local pwtd_reward = pwtd_weight * pwtd[start_idx + j]
                          local pltr_reward = pltr_weight * pltr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local pctr_reward = pctr_weight * pctr[start_idx + j] * 10.0

                          local element_score = 0.0
                          if use_multiply == 1 then
                            -- 乘法公式：只有权重 > 0 的目标才参与乘法，权重作为幂指数
                            -- 底数加 1.0 保证单调性：(1 + reward_base)^weight，避免底数<1时权重越大值越小
                            local multiply_score = 1.0
                            if pvtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pvtr[start_idx + j] * 0.1) ^ pvtr_weight)
                            end
                            if pwtd_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pwtd[start_idx + j] * 0.1) ^ pwtd_weight)
                            end
                            if pltr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pltr[start_idx + j] * 3.0) ^ pltr_weight)
                            end
                            if pctr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pctr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ pctr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pctr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pctr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pctr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pltr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pltr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pltr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pcmtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pcmtr[start_idx + j] * 2.0) ^ context_pcmtr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pwtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pwtr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pwtr_weight)
                            end
                            element_score = multiply_score
                          else
                            element_score = context_pwtd_reward + context_pctr_reward + context_plvtr_reward + context_psvtr_reward + context_pltr_reward + context_pcmtr_reward + context_pwtr_reward + context_pftr_reward + pvtr_reward + pltr_reward + pctr_reward + pwtd_reward
                          end
                          if enable_position_decay == 1 then
                            es_i = es_i + element_score * (1 / (0.3 + j^0.6))
                          else
                            es_i = es_i + element_score
                          end
                        end
                      end
                      scores[i] = es_i + list_es_i
                    end
                    return scores
                  end

rerank_list_padding_default_value.lua_script:
function calculate()
                  if rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list == nil or #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                    error("rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list为空或者长度不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                  end
                  local rerank_list_true_num = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list // rerank_list_item_size
                  local padded = {}
                  for i, v in ipairs(rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list) do
                    padded[i] = v
                  end
                  for i = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list + 1, rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size do
                    padded[i] = -1
                  end
                  return padded, rerank_list_true_num
                end
